== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Commander Vanden Willard (PC Errata 2018 E card)]]. Compared with [[Commander Vanden Willard (PC Errata 2018 disc card)]]. The whole 2018 disc card image and the whole 2018 E card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).

SHA-1 <code>9e157a146a2b5a490d3b11338f04dfa4eda43303</code>.
